label: CELL-Q // OS — Research Lab
scope: Educational quantitative research, nonfinancial synthetic data and evidence review
runtime: Pure local reducer reference; no network or persistence
integration: Requires explicit host adapter and research views; registry entry alone does not integrate this pack
notes: Role selection is a demo view, not authenticated identity.
Synthetic forecasting error is not evidence of financial performance.
currencyNote: No monetary values in this educational research domain
primaryUserGoal: Build a research workflow, inspect its models and produce a reviewed dossier
productOutcome: Create a bounded research workflow, inspect methods/results and produce a reviewed research dossier.
clockPolicy: Presentation/event timestamp clock only; no freshness-expiry enforcement in this reference.
resetPolicy: Reducer reset discards session research state. The standalone reference has separately labelled persistent preferences and local draft history; use its reset/settings controls as described.
